# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The following versions of our projects are actively supported with security updates:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Active  | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please do not open a public issue. Instead, report it by emailing the project maintainers at manthan.ank46@gmail.com.

Once a report is received, we will:
1. Acknowledge the receipt of your report within 48 hours.
2. Work on a fix and coordinate the release.
3. Provide updates throughout the process.
